facts.text: Cafe Hassui is housed in a 100-year-old building erected for 19th-century poets, with original artwork and calligraphic poems on the walls.
facts.excerpt: The café is housed in a 100-year-old building that was erected for 19th-century poets, and much of the original artwork remains, along with a collection of calligraphic poems composed on the walls.

facts.text: Cafe Hassui has a thatched straw roof, with indoor and outdoor terrace seating surrounded by views of the Arashiyama hills.
facts.excerpt: Shaded by a lush natural canopy and a thatched straw roof, indoor and outdoor terrace seating areas are surrounded by panoramic views of the enchanting Arashiyama hills.
